project: DK Quality Construction website — client-supplied project photos and reviews

conventions.assetId: DKQ-<batch 2 digits>-<seq 2 digits>, e.g. DKQ-01-03. Never reused or renumbered.
conventions.derivatives: src/assets/img/photos/<stored filename>-<width>.{avif,jpg}; widths include 320 (card thumbnails) from batch 7 on

batches.summary: 5 completed-project photos (4 decks incl. 1 aerial, 1 basement). No before/after pairs, no reviews.
3 completed decks (covered deck w/ stained ceiling + DK trailer, covered deck w/ white columns, brown deck by screened porch) and 2 views of one completed kitchen. No before/after pairs, no reviews.
3rd angle of the P-009 kitchen; 3 angles of one large ground-level deck (P-010, DK trailer visible); 1 deck under a pergola (P-011). No before/after pairs, no reviews.

2nd aerial deck (raised deck over screened room → new homepage hero), 1 pressure-treated deck (replaces last stock deck photo), stairs+landing project from 2 angles, 1 pond platform deck. No before/after pairs, no reviews.
3rd aerial deck (built-in benches → new homepage hero), above-ground pool deck, 2nd pressure-treated deck, 2 more completed decks. No before/after pairs, no reviews.

4th aerial deck (wraparound with covered porch → new homepage hero), front porch deck with benches, deck with planters, covered patio roof (new category), screened room (possible match to P-012). No before/after pairs, no reviews.

2 more views of P-012 (upper dining level + yard view), which also confirmed batch 6 screened room DKQ-06-05 is P-012 (P-025 merged/retired); covered front porch floor; ground-level picture-frame deck (dusk); side-yard deck with white railings. No before/after pairs, no reviews.

5th aerial (stone home, featured not hero — resolution), 2 decks with matching timber pavilions (treated + composite; possible same property flagged), angled picture-frame deck, low-res white-rail deck. No before/after pairs, no reviews.

2nd angle of P-021 (aerial), 2nd angle of P-030 (pavilion deck), covered brick-ranch porch (possible P-026 relation flagged), 6th aerial with DK trailer (About page), raised pressure-treated deck. No before/after pairs, no reviews.

Lakefront cable-rail deck, exact duplicate of homepage-hero aerial (DKQ-06-03), aerial of P-022 bench deck, cabin covered porch floor, large two-tone composite deck. No before/after pairs, no reviews.
